subject: english
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

A circular house made of blocks of hard snow
solution:
The correct answer is: **Igloo**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• An **igloo **is a circular house made of blocks of hard snow. (इग्लू कठोर बर्फ के खंडों से बना एक गोलाकार घर है)
 
• The word "igloo" comes from the Inuit language.
 
• Igloos are commonly used as temporary shelters in Arctic regions.
 
• The shape of an igloo helps to trap heat and keep the interior warm.
 
• Igloos can also be constructed using other materials, such as wood or metal.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nest**: A structure built by birds to hold eggs and provide shelter for their young. (घोंसला)
 
• **Hutch**: A cage or enclosure for small animals, such as rabbits. (पिञ्जरा)
 
• **Hut**: A small, simple dwelling, typically made of wood or other natural materials. (झोपड़ी)
